design_philosophy: A highly functional, 'Control Room' style dashboard designed for logistics operators, drivers, and admins. It uses a strictly structured, grid-based layout with sharp borders, prioritizing data density, scanability, and real-time mapping over decorative elements. High contrast accents are used exclusively for system status (warnings, live tracking, alerts).

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use generous spacing for main layout blocks (p-6, p-8) to ensure breathing room, but switch to dense tight grids (gap-4, p-4) inside analytics widgets and lists.
layout_and_spacing.dashboard_grid: The 'Control Room' grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 or 12-column grid. Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6).
layout_and_spacing.borders: Expose the skeleton. Use 1px solid borders (border-border) for widgets and structural divisions. Use border-collapse patterns where possible.
layout_and_spacing.radius: Keep it sharp. Max rounded-sm (4px) or rounded-none for a purely technical aesthetic.

surfaces_and_materials.dashboard_widgets: Flat solid backgrounds. 1px solid border. NO soft shadows. On hover: slight darken of border color, no lifting.
surfaces_and_materials.header_nav: Solid background with a hard bottom border (border-b border-border) to separate from the application body. Sticky positioning with z-50.
surfaces_and_materials.map_overlay: Floating panels over the Leaflet map should have a solid background (bg-white) with a hard 1px border and a subtle shadow (shadow-sm) to ensure high visibility against the map.

components.buttons: Square or minimally rounded. High contrast. Primary uses #002FA7. Must include hover state (hover:bg-opacity-90).
components.tables: Dense rows. Monospaced font for IDs, coordinates, and license plates. Hover states on rows are mandatory.
components.map: Leaflet.js. Use a light, low-contrast map tile (e.g., CartoDB Positron) so active truck markers, traffic overlays, and incident pins stand out immediately.
components.charts: Recharts. Avoid unnecessary axes lines. Use strict brand colors (Primary, Accent, Success, Warning) for bar and line charts.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All interactive elements must change background and text color explicitly on hover.
motion_and_interactions.live_indicators: Real-time GPS tracking dots and 'Live' status indicators must use a CSS pulsing animation (animate-ping).
motion_and_interactions.skeleton_loaders: Use Shadcn skeleton for all async dashboard panels (map loading, fetching analytics).

icons_and_assets.usage: Use icons heavily in the sidebar and action buttons, but keep them at small sizes (w-4 h-4 or w-5 h-5).

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid: ALL interactive elements, navigation links, and specific data readouts (like total trucks, carbon metrics) MUST include descriptive kebab-case 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., 'data-testid="map-truck-marker"').
testing_and_accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over map or colored badges maintains minimum WCAG AA standards (3:1 for large text, 4.5:1 for normal).

implementation_instructions_for_main_age: Override default generic sans fonts with 'IBM Plex Sans' for headings and 'IBM Plex Mono' for tabular/GPS data.
Implement the Layout using a Sidebar + Main Content pattern. The Sidebar should be dark (#0A0A0A) or high-contrast grey, while the Main Content is #F3F4F6 (background) with #FFFFFF cards.
For the Leaflet Map, use a custom DivIcon or standard marker for the trucks. Ensure the map is centered on Mumbai (19.0760, 72.8777).
Create 5 mock trucks moving on the map (simulate movement with setInterval) and 1 'real' truck representing the user.
Shadcn customized configuration: set 'radius' to 0.25rem or 0 in the CSS variables to match the 'Swiss Technical' theme.
Build the dashboard using pure grid syntax. Example: <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4">. Use col-span-2 or col-span-3 for the main charts.
For the ground reporting, provide a form with severity badges (Red, Yellow, Green) and map the submissions to a real-time feed list with upvote/downvote arrows.
